headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of July 31, 2026, the portfolio is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 19.32% compared to SPY's 10.24%. This outperformance translates to an average alpha of 9.08%, indicating that the portfolio is not only gaining in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A,' has achieved a remarkable return of 43.56%, significantly contributing to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B,' still maintains a positive return of 14.02%. This relative strength against SPY is particularly notable during periods of market uncertainty, showcasing the portfolio's resilience. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
